definitions.explanation: A disagreement or fight between people, groups, or nations. Can range from verbal arguments to physical or military conflicts.

examples.japanese: {隣人|りんじん}との{争|あらそ}いが{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The dispute with my neighbor continues.

examples.japanese: {兄弟|きょうだい}{間|かん}の{遺産|いさん}を{巡|めぐ}る{争|あらそ}いは、{家族|かぞく}{全体|ぜんたい}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えた。
examples.english: The dispute over inheritance between siblings affected the entire family.

notes:
{争|あらそ}い is the noun form of the verb {争|あらそ}う (to compete, to dispute).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {争|あらそ}いを{避|さ}ける (to avoid conflict)
- {争|あらそ}いを{起|お}こす (to start a dispute)
- {争|あらそ}いに{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる (to get caught up in a conflict)
- {領土|りょうど}{争|あらそ}い (territorial dispute)
- {権力|けんりょく}{争|あらそ}い (power struggle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喧嘩|けんか}: quarrel, fight (more casual, often personal)
- {紛争|ふんそう}: dispute, conflict (more formal, often international)
- {対立|たいりつ}: confrontation, opposition (emphasis on opposing sides)
